abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the incidence of the "floating ball" sign in cross-sectional imaging modalities in patients with ovarian teratoma, and to investigate the relationship between the morphologic features of the teratoma and this sign. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Preoperative computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging studies of 112 women with a pathologic diagnosis of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) were reviewed for the presence of the floating ball sign. Tumor size, tumor characteristics and the number, size, and characteristics of floating globules were evaluated. RESULTS: In 112 patients (mean age 35.5±16 years, range 5-84 years), 118 ovarian MCTs were diagnosed pathologically. The floating ball sign was demonstrated in cross-sectional imaging in 30 (25.4%) patients. Among 2 of them, MCT was associated with malignancy (squamous cell carcinoma). There was a significant relationship between the floating ball sign, tumor size, and the wall thickness of the tumor (p=0.003 and p=0.018, respectively). In linear regression analysis, a similarly significant relationship was found between the presence of this sign and tumor size and patient age (p=0.003 and p=0.035, respectively). CONCLUSION: The floating ball sign, as a pathognomonic sign for the diagnosis of ovarian teratomas, seems to be more common than is known. Although this sign is almost always seen in MCTs, it may rarely be seen in teratomas with malignant transformation. The relationship of this sign with the characteristics of the tumor can provide an insight into the occurrence of these balls.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣奇形腫患者において、断層画像診断法で「floating ball」徴候がみられる頻度を評価し、奇形腫の形態学的特徴とこの徴候との関係を検討すること。材料と方法：病理学的に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（MCT）と診断された女性112例の術前CTおよびMRI検査を見直し、floating ball徴候の有無を検討した。腫瘍の大きさ、腫瘍の性状、ならびに浮遊する小球の数、大きさ、性状を評価した。結果：112例（平均年齢35.5±16歳、範囲5〜84歳）において、病理学的に118個の卵巣MCTが診断された。断層画像診断でfloating ball徴候は30例（25.4%）に認められた。そのうち2例では、MCTに悪性腫瘍（扁平上皮癌）を合併していた。floating ball徴候と腫瘍の大きさ、および腫瘍壁の厚さとの間には有意な関連が認められた（それぞれp=0.003およびp=0.018）。線形回帰解析では、この徴候の有無と腫瘍の大きさ、患者の年齢との間に同様に有意な関連が認められた（それぞれp=0.003およびp=0.035）。結論：卵巣奇形腫の診断に特徴的な徴候であるfloating ball徴候は、知られているよりも一般的である可能性がある。この徴候はほぼ常にMCTで認められるが、悪性転化を伴う奇形腫ではまれに認められることもある。この徴候と腫瘍の特徴との関係は、これらの小球の発生機序を理解する手がかりとなりうる。
